title: Moya o o Botlhokwa o o Botsang Taolo
intro: Mo dibukeng tsa ditiragalo tsa Quran, go ne go tshela motho yo khumo le kitso ya gagwe di neng tsa nna tlhamane. Moya ono o ne wa tswa mo lefatsheng o na le mekgabiso le dikhumo tse di neng di phatsima babogedi, le fa go ntse jalo dipelo tsa bone di ne tsa nna mabela ka ntlha ya boikgogomoso. Kopanela le rona fa re ntse re phutholola masaitsiweng a nngwe ya dikinane tse di tlhagisang thata tsa Quran, moo bogolo jwa dilo tse di bonalang bo kopanang le bokhutlo jo bo kokobetsang ka fa tlase ga mmu o o ba tsetseng khumo.
clues: Ke ne ka tswa mo lefatsheng ke kgabisitswe ka mekgabiso e e neng e gapa matlho a mongwe le mongwe.
Ke ne ke na le dikhumo tse dintsintsi le kitso e e tseneletseng e e neng e dira gore ke farologane le ba bangwe.
Fa morongwa a tla a bitsa batho kwa go Allah, ke ne ka belaela taolo ya bone ka boikgogomoso.
Ba ba neng ba ntikologile ba ne ba sebaseba gore kamogelo ya ga Allah e ne e se motswedi wa khumo ya me.
Batho ba gaetsho ba ne ba gakgamadiwa ke bogolo jwa me mme ba eletsa gore ke nne le phelelo e e tshwanang le ya me.
Dikago tsa me tse dintlentle di ne tsa mediwa tsotlhe mo lefatsheng e le kotlhao ya bomodimo.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
